author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: Every failed HTMLLinkElement is reported as a stylesheet resource.
findings.consequence: Observability can misclassify failed link-backed resources such as modulepreload, preload, icons, or manifests as style failures, making browser error dashboards less accurate during asset or metadata outages.
findings.evidence: The packet-owned resourceKind function returns "style" for any target that is an HTMLLinkElement. The reporter and intake schema preserve only the compact resource_kind value, so this is the last point where link rel/as information can distinguish stylesheet links from other link resources.
findings.recommendation: Return "style" only for stylesheet links, for example when relList contains stylesheet or rel equals stylesheet; otherwise map recognized preload-as values such as script/image where safe, or return "unknown" for non-stylesheet link elements.
